pages.text: bring food, spare tools, blocks, and a way to see in the dark. eat a variety of foods as you find them - spice of life turns variety into extra hearts.$(br2)waystone travel is free on this server. activate one near home and others as you explore.
if you die, corail tombstone leaves a grave holding your items, and it waits forever - no decay, no timer. some of your xp doesn't make the trip. getting back to the grave is still your problem.
